description: This file defines an Angular component named NavbarComponent which manages the application’s navigation bar. It handles user authentication state, health status display, and UI interactions like toggling menu visibility and logout.

classes.name: NavbarComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for the application's navigation bar, including health status and authentication controls.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the boolean state of isOpen, controlling the visibility of the menu.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user via the AuthService and closes the menu for UX consistency.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string based on the health status for styling purposes.

methods.name: statusLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for the given health status.
